Every complementary region in a torus embedding is therefore
a disk, and both sequences require $B+ab+ad$ planar by
Corollary~\ref{cor:boundary-completions}.
Thus the retained graph is nontoroidal and must equal $G$.
Keeping a $K_{3,3}$ subdivision of $B+ab+ad$ and applying
Lemma~\ref{core:retained-subdivision} preserves this failure,
so minimality puts $B$ in Construction~\ref{common:marked-construction}
with added edges $ab,ad$.
There are $349$ possible bridges for each exterior. Every
assembled graph has a proper nontoroidal minor except for
two graphs in the $\{c,d,e\}$ case, both with
$B+ad+bd$ planar~\supp{E32}.
